_comment: Manual corrections for PDF layout/typo issues, keyed by 'LEVEL|raw head'. 'head' replaces the headword, 'merge_next' appends the next raw entry's examples, 'skip' drops the entry, 'examples'/'variants' replace the parsed lists, 'split' turns one raw entry into several ({head, examples}).
